name: Tonsillitis
source: Clinical guideline for tonsillitis diagnosis and management
note: Overlaps with Streptococcal Pharyngitis in this knowledge base — the distinguishing feature is visibly enlarged/swollen tonsils on exam, which a patient may or may not be able to self-report. Flagged explicitly because it affects rag_retrieve's ability to disambiguate between the two from symptom overlap alone.
